data.name: Mia
data.gender_notes: Mia is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Italian mia, 'mine', or a short form of Maria/Miriam. Its root is Italian mia. A modern Christian name. Mia is a Italian name meaning “Mine; (also) bitter; beloved”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mia expresses “Mine; (also) bitter; beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Italian mia, 'mine', or a short form of Maria/Miriam.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mia total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
